notes: No layout added: 17 April 2008 to 13 April 2011 stays undrawn. The dates are established (decree n° 114 of 17 April 2008 created Helwan out of Cairo and 6th of October out of Giza; both were dissolved on 14 April 2011; Luxor became a governorate on 7 December 2009), but the composition is not. No source that could be opened lists the aqsam and marakiz of the two governorates (the decree's text is a PDF behind manshurat.org's record; Arabic Wikipedia was blocked), and the lowest level available cannot carry the split in any case: geoBoundaries ADM2 puts each governorate's desert in a single unit named Zemam Out (Giza's is one 35,000 km² unit covering both the Western Desert, which went to 6th of October, and the east bank behind Atfih and El Saff, which went to Helwan; Cairo's is 1,500 km²), so Helwan's 7,500 km² cannot be assembled from whole units. Because a layout is the whole country, the change at Luxor on 7 December 2009 cannot be shown on its own either.
